name: saas-pricing-sso-tax-auditor
title: B2B SaaS Pricing Model, PLG & Enterprise SSO-Tax Auditor
description: Audits company pricing pages to extract SaaS pricing models (Seat vs Usage vs Tiered), PLG free tier / trial availability, lowest entry price, billing stack (Stripe/Chargebee/Paddle), and whether SAML/SSO is gated behind Enterprise ('SSO Tax'). Built for Clay.com, RevOps & VC research.
